scan_linter_check.description:
Flags string literals that exactly match (case-sensitive) the name of an existing user group or the user name of an existing user on the scanned instance. Role names are never reported, and arguments of role checks (hasRole, hasRoleExactly, hasRoles, hasRoleInGroup) are skipped. Users and groups are data: they are renamed, deactivated or missing on other instances, and a script that names them breaks silently.
Because matching uses the instance's own users and groups, results can differ between instances. Replaces the group-name part of the legacy check "NS: Hardcoded sys_ids, Emails, or Group Names", which matched any capitalized string near the word group.
scan_linter_check.name: SN-CFG-004: Hardcoded user or group name
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Store the user or group in a system property (preferably its sys_id, set per environment) or resolve it through configuration such as an assignment rule, instead of naming it in the script.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A string literal is the name of an existing user group or a user name.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SN-CFG-004: Hardcoded user or group name
